AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: Time trends in the number of publications of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in asthma research have never been evaluated.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: A PubMed database scan was made to identify publications in asthma research per year since 1990 until 1 January 2010, using the term 'asthma'. The total number of publications was ascertained, as was the number when restricting the search strategy to RCTs only.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The total number of publications in asthma research increased from 2240 per year in 1990 to 5601 per year in 2009. The number of publications of RCTs in asthma research was 198 per year in 1990 and 233 per year in 2009.

AbstractText.Label: DISCUSSION
AbstractText.content: The remarkable phenomenon of an almost unchanged number of publications of RCTs in asthma research per year in the period 1990-2009 may be explained by criticism to RCTs in asthma research.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: Despite an increase in total publications of asthma research, time trends in the number of publications of RCTs in asthma research per year show an almost unchanged number in the period 1990-2009. Evidence-based medicine within the field of asthma still faces many challenges.
